kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتعرقب (form IIq)
# أَتَعَرْقَبُ (ʔataʕarqabu) /ʔa.ta.ʕar.qa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# أُتَعَرْقَبُ (ʔutaʕarqabu) /ʔu.ta.ʕar.qa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# أَتَعَرْقَبَ (ʔataʕarqaba) /ʔa.ta.ʕar.qa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# أُتَعَرْق
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
